basic_details.job_title: Ministry of Ayush Recruitment 2026 – Apply Offline for 3 Program Manager, Data Assistant Posts
basic_details.short_information: The Ministry of Ayush (आयुष मंत्रालय), Government of India, is filling 3 contractual posts in the Programme Management Unit (PMU) of the Central Sector Scheme Ayush Oushadhi Gunvatta Evam Uttpadan Samvardhan Yojana (AOGUSY): 1 Program Manager (Accounts) and 2 Data Assistant/ Data Entry Operator. Applications in the prescribed format (Annexure-I) are to be sent to the Drug Policy Section of the Ministry in New Delhi and must be received up to 5:30 PM on 3 December 2026. Applications received after the last date will not be entertained.

qualification.details: The notice does not give a category-wise break-up of the 3 posts, and it does not mention any age relaxation. | The remuneration will be reviewed periodically in consultation with IFD as per the scheme guidelines. TDS and other taxes will be levied as applicable. TA/DA entitlements for Programme Management Staff on tour are as per Government of India Rules. Except TA/DA on tour as applicable, no transport, mobile, medical or any other kind of allowance shall be admissible. | For the discipline-specific eligibility of each post, candidates should check the official notification.

content_sections.heading: Ministry of Ayush Recruitment 2026 at a Glance
content_sections.text: The official notification does not specify the application fee or the selection process.

rows.details: Ministry of Ayush, Government of India
Program Manager (Accounts); Data Assistant/ Data Entry Operator

MBA(Finance)/M.Com for Program Manager (Accounts); Graduation with computer knowledge for Data Assistant/ Data Entry Operator
Contract basis, initially up to 31.03.2027 (which may be extended)

content_sections.heading: About Ministry of Ayush Recruitment 2026
content_sections.text: The posts belong to the Programme Management Unit (PMU) set up for the Central Sector Scheme of Ayush Oushadhi Gunvatta Evam Uttpadan Samvardhan Yojana (AOGUSY) of the Ministry of Ayush, Government of India. The vacancy circular is signed by the Deputy Director, Ministry of Ayush, on 18 November 2026, and applications are handled by the Drug Policy Section of the Ministry in East Kidwai Nagar, New Delhi.

content_sections.heading: Where and How to Send
content_sections.text: The application must be made in the prescribed format, the Application Form given as Annexure-I with the circular (in English and Hindi). The circular states that the application completed in all aspects may be sent to this address: Drug Policy Section, Ministry of Ayush, NBCC, Office Block-III 2nd Floor, East Kidwai Nagar, New Delhi- 110023 The application must reach the Ministry up to 5:30 PM on 3 December 2026. The notice does not mention a particular postal mode (speed post, registered post or by hand) or any text to be written on the envelope. The Annexure-I form asks for:

content_sections.heading: Posts, Eligibility and Pay
content_sections.text: The notice does not give a category-wise break-up of the 3 posts, and it does not mention any age relaxation. The remuneration will be reviewed periodically in consultation with IFD as per the scheme guidelines. TDS and other taxes will be levied as applicable. TA/DA entitlements for Programme Management Staff on tour are as per Government of India Rules. Except TA/DA on tour as applicable, no transport, mobile, medical or any other kind of allowance shall be admissible. For the discipline-specific eligibility of each post, candidates should check the official notification.

rows.age_limit: Not exceeding 50 years as on the date of the advertisement
Not exceeding 40 years as on the date of Advertisement

content_sections.heading: Ministry of Ayush Recruitment 2026 Job Description
content_sections.text: The circular prints one list of responsibilities in the detailed Terms of Reference (ToR) of the post(s), common to the PMU posts: Overall coordination/monitoring of the Scheme including Technical, Administrative and Financial aspects. Evaluation of the proposals submitted by the Grantee Institutes/State/UT Governments. To coordinate & liaison and brief the officers of M/o AYUSH on success, problems and issues on implementation of the Scheme. To analyse issues and submit reports (including action points as per requirements) on status of the Scheme. To call Project Appraisal Committee (PAC) and Project Sanctioning Committee (PSC) meeting periodically. Any other work assigned by Senior Officers time to time.

content_sections.heading: Enclosures
content_sections.text: Recent passport size colour photo (affixed on the form). Self-attested copy of proof of age. Self-attested copies of educational qualifications. Self-attested copies supporting previous/current employment. All documents attached as proof of age, qualification and experience mentioned serially with proper page numbering.

faq.question: Q1. How many vacancies are in Ministry of Ayush Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There are 3 vacancies: 1 Program Manager (Accounts) and 2 Data Assistant/ Data Entry Operator in the PMU of the AOGUSY scheme.

faq.question: Q2. What is the last date to apply?
faq.answer: Applications must be received up to 5:30 PM on 3 December 2026; applications received after the last date will not be entertained.

faq.question: Q3. What is the qualification for Program Manager (Accounts)?
faq.answer: The essential qualification is MBA(Finance)/M.Com, and at least 3 years experience in any State department/ Ministry/ Ayush Research Councils/ Public Sector Undertakings is desirable.

faq.question: Q4. What is the qualification for Data Assistant/ Data Entry Operator?
faq.answer: Graduation from a recognized institute or University with sound knowledge of Computer Application/ IT, knowledge of MS Office applications, typing speed of 35 wpm in English and 30 wpm in Hindi, and at least 3 years experience in any State Department/Ministry/ Research Councils/Public Sector Undertakings.

faq.question: Q5. What is the age limit?
faq.answer: Not exceeding 50 years for Program Manager (Accounts) and not exceeding 40 years for Data Assistant/ Data Entry Operator, as on the date of the advertisement.

faq.question: Q6. What is the salary?
faq.answer: Program Manager (Accounts) gets Rs. 50,000/- with a provision of 5% annual enhancement based on satisfactory performance; Data Assistant/ Data Entry Operator gets Rs. 23,082/- per month or minimum wages for graduates as decided by the Govt. of NCT.

faq.question: Q7. How do I apply?
faq.answer: Fill the Annexure-I application form with self-attested documents and send it to Drug Policy Section, Ministry of Ayush, NBCC, Office Block-III 2nd Floor, East Kidwai Nagar, New Delhi- 110023, to reach by 5:30 PM on 3 December 2026.

faq.question: Q8. Is this a permanent job?
faq.answer: No, the engagement is on contract basis, initially for a period up to 31.03.2027, which may be extended.

faq.question: Q9. Are any allowances paid on top of the remuneration?
faq.answer: Only TA/DA on tour as per Government of India Rules; no transport, mobile, medical or any other kind of allowance shall be admissible.

faq.question: Q10. How much leave is allowed?
faq.answer: Paid leave may be allowed at 1.5 days for each completed month of service, with no accumulation beyond a calendar year and pro-rata deduction for excess leave.
